mapper.select: select m.model_code as modelCode, m.model_name as modelName, m.model_type as modelType from model_group_models mgm join models m on m.id = mgm.model_id where mgm.group_id = #{groupId} and m.deleted = 0 and m.status = 'ACTIVE' and exists ( select 1 from model_routes r join providers p on p.id = r.provider_id and p.deleted = 0 and p.status = 'ACTIVE' join provider_tokens t on t.provider_id = p.id and t.deleted = 0 and t.status = 'ACTIVE' where r.model_id = m.id and r.status = 'ACTIVE' and r.upstream_model is not null and r.upstream_model <> '' ) group by m.model_code, m.model_name, m.model_type order by max(m.id) desc

select m.model_code as modelCode, m.model_name as modelName, m.model_type as modelType from models m where m.deleted = 0 and m.status = 'ACTIVE' and m.is_public = 1 and exists ( select 1 from model_routes r join providers p on p.id = r.provider_id and p.deleted = 0 and p.status = 'ACTIVE' join provider_tokens t on t.provider_id = p.id and t.deleted = 0 and t.status = 'ACTIVE' where r.model_id = m.id and r.status = 'ACTIVE' and r.upstream_model is not null and r.upstream_model <> '' ) group by m.model_code, m.model_name, m.model_type order by max(m.id) desc
